### Health Analytics with R · Module 07: Geospatial & Spatial Epidemiology
***
**Learning objectives**
- Compute travel distance and catchment-area access metrics
- Implement the Two-Step Floating Catchment Area (2SFCA) method
- Build provider-to-population ratio metrics by service area
- Delineate Health Professional Shortage Areas (HPSA-style analysis)
- Compute network accessibility indices for hospital and primary care
- Map spatial disparities in healthcare access

**Estimated time:** 2.5 hours | **Level:** Advanced  
**Libraries:** `sf`, `ggplot2`, `dplyr`

## 1. Setup


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(patchwork)

set.seed(42)
out_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "mod07")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
)

spatial_smooth <- function(values, row_idx, col_idx, nrow, ncol, sigma = 2) {
  grid <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow, ncol = ncol)
  for (i in seq_along(values)) grid[row_idx[i], col_idx[i]] <- values[i]
  k <- ceiling(3 * sigma)
  xs <- (-k):k
  kern <- outer(dnorm(xs, sd = sigma), dnorm(xs, sd = sigma))
  kern <- kern / sum(kern)
  pad <- k
  gp <- matrix(0, nrow + 2 * pad, ncol + 2 * pad)
  gp[(pad + 1):(pad + nrow), (pad + 1):(pad + ncol)] <- grid
  out <- matrix(0, nrow, ncol)
  for (r in seq_len(nrow)) for (c in seq_len(ncol)) {
    out[r, c] <- sum(gp[r:(r + 2 * k), c:(c + 2 * k)] * kern)
  }
  mapply(function(r, c) out[r, c], row_idx, col_idx)
}

NROW <- 10; NCOL <- 20; N <- NROW * NCOL
row_idx <- rep(seq_len(NROW), each = NCOL)
col_idx <- rep(seq_len(NCOL), times = NROW)
lon <- -120 + (col_idx - 1) * 2.5 + rnorm(N, 0, 0.3)
lat <- 28 + (row_idx - 1) * 2.0 + rnorm(N, 0, 0.2)
pct_poverty <- 10 + 8 * rbeta(N, 2, 5) + 3 * sin(lon / 20)
pct_uninsured <- 8 + 6 * rbeta(N, 2, 4) + 0.3 * pct_poverty
pm25 <- 8 + 4 * rgamma(N, 2, 1)
population <- as.integer(rlnorm(N, 10.5, 1.0))
spatial_risk <- spatial_smooth(rnorm(N), row_idx, col_idx, NROW, NCOL)
cvd_rate <- (180 + 1.2 * pct_poverty + 0.8 * pct_uninsured + 0.5 * pm25 +
               15 * spatial_risk + rnorm(N, 0, 12))
expected <- (cvd_rate / 100000) * population * 5
observed <- rpois(N, expected)
smr <- observed / pmax(expected, 1)

df <- tibble(
  county_id = sprintf("C%03d", seq_len(N) - 1),
  lon, lat, row = row_idx, col = col_idx,
  pct_poverty, pct_uninsured, pm25, population, cvd_rate, observed, expected, smr
)
geoms <- Map(function(lo, la) {
  st_polygon(list(matrix(
    c(lo - 1.25, la - 1, lo + 1.25, la - 1, lo + 1.25, la + 1,
      lo - 1.25, la + 1, lo - 1.25, la - 1), ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE
  )))
}, df$lon, df$lat)
gdf <- st_sf(df, geometry = st_sfc(geoms, crs = 4326))

set.seed(5)
N_HOSP <- 40
hosp_type <- sample(
  c("Critical_Access", "Community", "Regional", "Academic"),
  N_HOSP, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.30, 0.40, 0.20, 0.10)
)
hosp_beds <- dplyr::case_when(
  hosp_type == "Academic"        ~ sample(400:800, N_HOSP, replace = TRUE),
  hosp_type == "Regional"        ~ sample(150:400, N_HOSP, replace = TRUE),
  hosp_type == "Community"       ~ sample(50:200, N_HOSP, replace = TRUE),
  TRUE                           ~ sample(25:75, N_HOSP, replace = TRUE)
)
df_hosp <- st_as_sf(
  tibble(lon = runif(N_HOSP, min(lon), max(lon)),
         lat = runif(N_HOSP, min(lat), max(lat)),
         type = hosp_type, beds = hosp_beds),
  coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326
)
cat(sprintf("N=%d counties | %d hospitals | CVD=%.1f/100k\n", N, N_HOSP, mean(cvd_rate)))
```

## 2. Access Metrics Framework

**Primary care access metrics:**

| Metric | Formula | Limitation |
|--------|---------|-----------|
| **Provider:population ratio** | Providers / Population | Ignores distance |
| **Distance to nearest** | min(d_ij) | Ignores capacity |
| **2SFCA** | Sum of weighted provider ratios | Most comprehensive |
| **Gravity model** | Sum(S_j / d^p) | Power-law decay |
| **Floating catchment** | Within d miles of provider | Binary, ignores gradients |

**Two-Step Floating Catchment Area (2SFCA):**
1. Step 1: For each provider j, compute R_j = Beds_j / Σ(Pop_i for i within d)
2. Step 2: For each county i, A_i = Σ(R_j for j within d of i)
Higher A_i = better access.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
dist_m <- st_distance(centroids, df_hosp)
dist_matrix <- matrix(as.numeric(dist_m), nrow = nrow(dist_m), ncol = ncol(dist_m))
# If values look like metres, convert; with s2 off, geographic distance is in degrees
if (max(dist_matrix, na.rm = TRUE) > 50) {
  dist_matrix <- dist_matrix / 111000  # metres -> approximate degrees
}

CATCHMENT_DEG <- 4.5  # ~5 degrees ≈ 300 miles

ppr <- numeric(N)
for (i in seq_len(N)) {
  in_c <- dist_matrix[i, ] <= CATCHMENT_DEG
  if (any(in_c)) {
    total_beds <- sum(df_hosp$beds[in_c])
    ppr[i] <- total_beds / (df$population[i] / 1000)
  }
}
gdf$ppr_beds_per_1000 <- ppr
gdf$dist_nearest_hosp <- apply(dist_matrix, 1, min)

two_sfca <- function(county_pop, dist, provider_cap, catchment, decay_power = 1) {
  n_i <- length(county_pop)
  n_j <- length(provider_cap)
  R_j <- numeric(n_j)
  for (j in seq_len(n_j)) {
    in_zone <- dist[, j] <= catchment
    denom <- sum(county_pop[in_zone] / (dist[in_zone, j] + 0.1)^decay_power)
    R_j[j] <- if (denom > 0) provider_cap[j] / denom else 0
  }
  A_i <- numeric(n_i)
  for (i in seq_len(n_i)) {
    in_zone <- dist[i, ] <= catchment
    if (any(in_zone)) {
      weights <- 1 / (dist[i, in_zone] + 0.1)^decay_power
      A_i[i] <- sum(R_j[in_zone] * weights)
    }
  }
  A_i
}

gdf$access_2sfca <- two_sfca(
  df$population, dist_matrix, df_hosp$beds,
  catchment = CATCHMENT_DEG, decay_power = 2
)
cat("Access metrics computed:\n")
```

```{.r .cell-code}
map_access <- function(col, title, palette, dir = 1) {
  ggplot(gdf) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = .data[[col]]), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
    geom_sf(data = df_hosp, shape = 3, size = 2, colour = "black") +
    scale_fill_distiller(palette = palette, direction = dir) +
    labs(title = title, x = "Lon", y = "Lat", fill = NULL)
}

p_acc <- (map_access("ppr_beds_per_1000", "Beds per 1,000 Pop (Simple PPR)", "Blues", 1) |
  map_access("dist_nearest_hosp", "Distance to Nearest Hospital (°)", "RdYlGn", -1)) /
  (map_access("access_2sfca", "2SFCA Access Score", "RdYlGn", 1) |
  map_access("pct_uninsured", "% Uninsured (demand-side barrier)", "YlOrRd", 1))
p_acc <- p_acc + plot_annotation(title = "Healthcare Access Atlas: Multiple Metrics")
print(p_acc)
```

## 3. HPSA-Style Shortage Area Delineation


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
HPSA_PPR_THRESHOLD <- 0.286  # 1 per 3,500 = 0.286 per 1,000
HPSA_DIST_THRESHOLD <- 3.5   # ~30 miles in degrees

score_ppr  <- 1 - pmin(gdf$ppr_beds_per_1000 / quantile(gdf$ppr_beds_per_1000, 0.9), 1)
score_dist <- pmin(gdf$dist_nearest_hosp / quantile(gdf$dist_nearest_hosp, 0.9), 1)
score_2sfca <- 1 - pmin(gdf$access_2sfca / quantile(gdf$access_2sfca, 0.9), 1)
score_uninsured <- pmin(gdf$pct_uninsured / quantile(gdf$pct_uninsured, 0.9), 1)

gdf$hpsa_score <- (score_ppr + score_dist + score_2sfca + score_uninsured) / 4
gdf$hpsa_status <- cut(
  gdf$hpsa_score,
  breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.01),
  labels = c("Adequate", "Low shortage", "Moderate shortage", "HPSA"),
  include.lowest = TRUE
)

hpsa_colors <- c(
  Adequate = "#2563EB", `Low shortage` = "#B3CDE3",
  `Moderate shortage` = "#FEC44F", HPSA = "#DC2626"
)

p_hpsa <- ggplot(gdf) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = hpsa_status), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
  geom_sf(data = df_hosp, shape = 3, size = 2.2, colour = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = hpsa_colors) +
  labs(title = "Health Professional Shortage Areas (HPSA-style)",
       fill = NULL, x = "Lon", y = "Lat")

pop_by_status <- gdf %>% st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(hpsa_status) %>%
  summarise(pop = sum(population), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(pct = pop / sum(gdf$population) * 100)

p_pop <- ggplot(pop_by_status, aes(hpsa_status, pct, fill = hpsa_status)) +
  geom_col(colour = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", pct)), vjust = -0.3, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = hpsa_colors, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "% of total population", title = "Population by Access Category")

p_h <- p_hpsa | p_pop
print(p_h)
```

## 4. Disparities in Access by SES


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
access_corrs <- list()
for (metric in c("ppr_beds_per_1000", "dist_nearest_hosp", "access_2sfca")) {
  ct_p <- cor.test(gdf$pct_poverty, gdf[[metric]])
  ct_u <- cor.test(gdf$pct_uninsured, gdf[[metric]])
  access_corrs[[metric]] <- tibble(
    metric = metric,
    r_poverty = unname(ct_p$estimate), p_poverty = ct_p$p.value,
    r_uninsured = unname(ct_u$estimate), p_uninsured = ct_u$p.value
  )
}
corr_tab <- bind_rows(access_corrs)
print(corr_tab)
```

```{.r .cell-code}
concentration_index <- function(health, rank_var) {
  n <- length(health)
  rank <- rank(rank_var) / n
  2 * cov(rank, health) / mean(health)
}

ci_poverty_access <- concentration_index(gdf$access_2sfca, gdf$pct_poverty)
cat(sprintf("\nConcentration Index (2SFCA access by poverty rank): %.4f\n", ci_poverty_access))
```

## 5. Knowledge Check
1. 2SFCA gives county A score=0.82 and county B score=0.14. Both have the same distance to the nearest hospital. What could explain the large difference?
2. The concentration index is -0.31. A health minister says "access is distributed equitably." Is this correct?
3. Your HPSA analysis uses distance in degrees. Why is this problematic, and what would you use instead?
4. A large Academic Medical Centre opens in a rural county. How would each of the four access metrics change?
5. Implement a Gini coefficient for healthcare access to quantify inequality across all counties.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
gini_coefficient <- function(values) {
  sorted_v <- sort(values)
  n <- length(sorted_v)
  cumulative <- cumsum(sorted_v)
  total <- cumulative[n]
  lorenz <- c(0, cumulative / total)
  x <- seq(0, 1, length.out = n + 1)
  trapz <- sum(diff(x) * (head(lorenz, -1) + tail(lorenz, -1)) / 2)
  list(gini = 1 - 2 * trapz, lorenz = lorenz, x = x)
}

for (pair in list(c("access_2sfca", "2SFCA Access"),
                  c("ppr_beds_per_1000", "Beds per 1000"))) {
  g <- gini_coefficient(gdf[[pair[1]]])
  cat(sprintf("Gini coefficient for %s: %.4f\n", pair[2], g$gini))
}
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
Gini coefficient for 2SFCA Access: 0.6282
Gini coefficient for Beds per 1000: 0.6824
```


:::

```{.r .cell-code}
g_access <- gini_coefficient(gdf$access_2sfca)
p_lor <- ggplot(tibble(x = g_access$x, y = g_access$lorenz), aes(x, y)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = y, ymax = x), fill = "#DC2626", alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_line(colour = "#DC2626", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    x = "Cumulative % of counties (sorted by access)",
    y = "Cumulative % of total access",
    title = "Lorenz Curve: Healthcare Access Distribution",
    subtitle = sprintf("2SFCA Lorenz (Gini=%.3f)", g_access$gini)
  )
print(p_lor)
```
